name: member-fmt
command: import subprocess,json;d=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['cargo','metadata','--no-deps','--format-version','1','--locked']));cmd=['cargo','fmt'];[cmd.extend(['-p',p['name']]) for p in d['packages'] if p['id'] in d['workspace_members']];raise SystemExit(subprocess.run(cmd+['--','--check']).returncode)
